title: Psikofen
summary: Psikofen is a mummy-like Hecto-Titan who, through the use of its deadly chains that come out of its hands, can ensnare enemies or violently tear through solid structures, making him a dangerous and formidable opponent. Closely related to the Titan Marauder, Psikofen is used by Marduk and the Casterwill Hunters of the Blood Spiral.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Psikofen was invoked by a [[Casterwill Hunter]] in the Salon airfield when the Huntik team were ambushed just after landing their plane. After destroying the plane, Psikofen battled against [[Ironsquire]] and [[Kelpie]]. Though Psikofen gained the edge in the battle, he began to slow down out of fatigue, which allowed [[Cherit]] to defeat him with his energy charge. Another Psikofen was used by [[Marduk]] to attack the team in Nostradamus's tomb. He battled [[Dullahan]] and [[Elf King Oberon]] and sabotaged the team's plans but, after a fierce fight, he was defeated by [[Baselaird|Powerbonded Baselaird]]. {{source|Words from Eathon}}

During the battle at the [[Spiral Mark]], Psikofen was invoked by a Casterwill Hunter to fight against the [[Huntik Foundation]] and [[Casterwill family]]. Psikofen was able to capture [[Lane]] and render her unconscious before being sent back to its amulet when hit by [[Montehue]]'s flying axe. {{source|Lok and the Betrayer}}

Another Psikofen was used by Marduk to attack the team in Nostradamus's tomb. He battled Dullahan and Elf King Oberon and sabotaged the team's plans but, after a fierce fight, he was defeated by Powerbonded Baselaird. [Words from Eathon]

During the battle at the Spiral Mark, Psikofen was invoked by a Casterwill Hunter to fight against the Huntik Foundation and Casterwill family. Psikofen was able to capture Lane and render her unconscious before being sent back to its amulet when hit by Montehue's flying axe. [Lok and the Betrayer]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:
Image caption: Psikofen singlehandedly tears apart the Huntik Foundation Jet

Psikofen's strength lies in its ability to use its chains as weapons, often targeting his enemies by the ankles so as to demobilize them before moving into finish them off; or even using them to pull away opponents' shields or defend itself against spells. The power Psikofen has in controlling these chains mean he is strong enough to single-handedly destroy a plane and can capture enemies as strong as Baselaird. It can also fire a laser from its forehead. Despite his strength, Psikofen lacks stamina, and will slow down as he gets tired from maneuvering his chains, something which Lok Lambert and Cherit exploited, sending it back to its amulet with the latter's Energy Charge. Psikofen is also limited by only having one chain in each arm (one with a sphere at the end and the other one with a piercing diamond-shaped end), meaning that if it tries to ensnare two enemies at once without finishing them off, it will be left vulnerable. Its chains can be used against it if an opponent is able to grab them, making Psikofen trip. [Words from Eathon]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*Psikofen's summoning command is "'''Rampage!'''"
*Psikofen's design is partially inspired by the character [https://saintseiya.fandom.com/wiki/Andromeda_Shun Andromeda Shun] from the anime/manga franchise ''Saint Seiya''. Both characters fight using a dual-wrist chain system where one chain ends in a blunt sphere and the other ends in a triangular/diamond-shaped point.
